<style>
/* ============ NEÓN CLÁSICO — variables y base ============ */
:root{
  --bg:#07030f; --bg2:#0d0620;
  --neon-cyan:#00f0ff;   /* FRONT */
  --neon-magenta:#ff2bd6;/* BACK */
  --neon-green:#39ff14;
  --neon-violet:#b026ff;
  --neon-yellow:#fff200;
  --txt:#e8e6f0; --dim:#a9a3c2;
  --panel:#0b0518; --code-bg:#050308;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0;padding:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--txt);
  font-family:'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif;}
body::before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:-1;pointer-events:none;
  background:
    linear-gradient(rgba(0,240,255,.05) 1px, transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,43,214,.05) 1px, transparent 1px),
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% -10%, #1a0b35 0%, var(--bg2) 45%, var(--bg) 100%);
  background-size:34px 34px, 34px 34px, 100% 100%;}
.wrap{max-width:1400px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 14px 60px}

/* título cartel de neón */
.app-title{font-size:clamp(20px,3.2vw,30px);letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--neon-cyan);
  text-shadow:0 0 6px var(--neon-cyan),0 0 16px rgba(0,240,255,.55);margin:14px 0 4px;font-weight:800;}
.app-sub{color:var(--dim);font-size:12.5px;margin:0 0 10px}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference){
  .flicker{animation:flick 5s infinite steps(1,end)}
  @keyframes flick{0%,92%,96%,100%{opacity:1}93%{opacity:.55}94%{opacity:.85}97%{opacity:.7}}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){ *{animation:none!important;transition:none!important} }

/* barra superior */
.topbar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;align-items:center;border:1px solid var(--neon-violet);
  border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px;background:rgba(11,5,24,.7);box-shadow:0 0 6px rgba(176,38,255,.4), inset 0 0 14px rgba(176,38,255,.08)}
.main-tabs{display:flex;gap:8px}
.mtab{background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--dim);color:var(--txt);padding:9px 18px;
  border-radius:8px;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;letter-spacing:.05em}
.mtab.active{border-color:var(--neon-cyan);color:var(--neon-cyan);
  box-shadow:0 0 6px var(--neon-cyan), inset 0 0 10px rgba(0,240,255,.15);text-shadow:0 0 6px rgba(0,240,255,.7)}
.searchbox{flex:1;min-width:180px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.searchbox input{width:100%;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--dim);color:var(--txt);
  padding:9px 12px;border-radius:8px;font-size:14px}
.searchbox input:focus-visible{outline:none;border-color:var(--neon-yellow);box-shadow:0 0 6px var(--neon-yellow)}
.optgroup{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--dim)}
.optgroup label{display:flex;gap:5px;align-items:center;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap}
input[type=checkbox]{accent-color:var(--neon-green);width:15px;height:15px;cursor:pointer}
.legend{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;font-size:12.5px}
.badge{display:inline-block;padding:2px 9px;border-radius:20px;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.06em}
.badge.back{color:var(--neon-magenta);border:1px solid var(--neon-magenta);box-shadow:0 0 6px rgba(255,43,214,.5)}
.badge.front{color:var(--neon-cyan);border:1px solid var(--neon-cyan);box-shadow:0 0 6px rgba(0,240,255,.5)}

/* layout con sidebar */
.layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:250px 1fr;gap:16px;margin-top:16px}
.sidebar{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;position:sticky;top:10px;align-self:start;max-height:calc(100vh - 20px);overflow:auto}
.side-label{font-size:11px;color:var(--dim);letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;margin:6px 2px 2px}
.sbtn{display:block;width:100%;text-align:left;background:transparent;border:1px solid transparent;
  color:var(--txt);padding:8px 10px;border-radius:8px;font-size:13.5px;cursor:pointer;line-height:1.3}
.sbtn:hover{border-color:var(--neon-violet);box-shadow:0 0 6px rgba(176,38,255,.5)}
.sbtn.active{border-color:var(--neon-cyan);color:var(--neon-cyan);box-shadow:0 0 6px rgba(0,240,255,.45);background:rgba(0,240,255,.05)}
select.mobilenav{display:none;width:100%;background:var(--panel);color:var(--txt);border:1px solid var(--neon-violet);border-radius:8px;padding:10px;font-size:14px}

/* tarjetas de contenido */
.card{border:1px solid var(--neon-violet);border-radius:12px;padding:16px 18px;margin-bottom:16px;
  background:rgba(11,5,24,.72);box-shadow:0 0 6px rgba(176,38,255,.28), inset 0 0 22px rgba(176,38,255,.05)}
.card h2{margin:0 0 8px;color:var(--neon-cyan);font-size:21px;text-shadow:0 0 6px rgba(0,240,255,.6)}
.card h3{color:var(--neon-yellow);font-size:16px;margin:16px 0 6px;text-shadow:0 0 5px rgba(255,242,0,.35)}
.card p,.card li{line-height:1.55;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--txt)}
.card ul{margin:6px 0;padding-left:22px}
.hint{color:var(--dim);font-size:12.5px}
mark{background:var(--neon-yellow);color:#000;padding:0 2px;border-radius:3px}
.warn-list li{margin-bottom:7px}
table.neon-table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;margin:8px 0;font-size:13.5px}
.neon-table th{color:var(--neon-cyan);border-bottom:1px solid var(--neon-cyan);padding:6px 8px;text-align:left;white-space:nowrap}
.neon-table td{border-bottom:1px solid rgba(169,163,194,.22);padding:6px 8px;vertical-align:top}
pre.inline-code, code{font-family:Consolas,'Courier New',monospace}
.card :not(pre) > code{background:#160a2b;border:1px solid rgba(176,38,255,.4);border-radius:5px;padding:1px 5px;font-size:12.8px;color:#aef7ff}

/* bloques de código */
.codeblock{border:1px solid var(--neon-cyan);border-radius:10px;margin:10px 0;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 0 6px rgba(0,240,255,.25)}
.codeblock.back-border{border-color:var(--neon-magenta);box-shadow:0 0 6px rgba(255,43,214,.28)}
.code-head{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:7px 10px;background:#120826;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(0,240,255,.25)}
.code-title{font-weight:700;font-size:13px;color:var(--txt)}
.code-file{font-family:Consolas,'Courier New',monospace;font-size:12px;color:var(--neon-yellow)}
.btn-copy{margin-left:auto;background:transparent;color:var(--neon-green);border:1px solid var(--neon-green);
  border-radius:7px;padding:5px 12px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap}
.btn-copy:hover,.btn-copy:focus-visible{box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--neon-green);outline:none}
pre.code{margin:0;padding:12px 14px;background:var(--code-bg);color:#e8f6fa;
  font-family:Consolas,'Courier New',monospace;font-size:12.6px;line-height:1.5;
  overflow:auto;white-space:pre;tab-size:2;max-height:520px}

/* generador: acordeón + split */
.gen-desc{color:var(--dim);font-size:13.5px;margin:2px 0 10px}
.gitem{border:1px solid var(--dim);border-radius:10px;margin-bottom:10px;overflow:hidden;background:rgba(11,5,24,.6)}
.gitem.open{border-color:var(--neon-cyan);box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(0,240,255,.35)}
.ghead{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:11px 14px;cursor:pointer;gap:10px}
.gtitle{font-weight:700;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--txt)}
.gitem.open .gtitle{color:var(--neon-cyan);text-shadow:0 0 5px rgba(0,240,255,.5)}
.gbody{display:none;padding:6px 14px 14px}
.gitem.open .gbody{display:block}
.gen-split{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(260px,380px) 1fr;gap:16px}
.gen-fields{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.field label{display:block;font-size:12.8px;color:var(--dim);margin-bottom:3px}
.field input[type=text],.field input[type=number],.field select,.field textarea{
  width:100%;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--dim);color:var(--txt);
  border-radius:7px;padding:9px 10px;font-size:14px;font-family:inherit}
.field textarea{font-family:Consolas,'Courier New',monospace;font-size:12.8px;resize:vertical}
.field input:focus-visible,.field select:focus-visible,.field textarea:focus-visible{
  outline:none;border-color:var(--neon-cyan);box-shadow:0 0 6px rgba(0,240,255,.5)}
.field.check{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center}
.field.check label{margin:0;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--txt)}
.field-help{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--dim);margin-top:2px}
.field-error{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--neon-yellow);margin-top:2px}
.gen-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:6px}
.btn-reset{background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--neon-violet);color:var(--neon-violet);
  border-radius:7px;padding:6px 12px;font-size:12.5px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:700}
.btn-reset:hover{box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(176,38,255,.6)}
.btn-copyall{background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--neon-green);color:var(--neon-green);
  border-radius:7px;padding:6px 12px;font-size:12.5px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:700}
.btn-copyall:hover{box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--neon-green)}
.gen-result{min-width:0}
.empty{color:var(--dim);font-style:italic;padding:14px}

/* mapa de carpetas interactivo */
.tree{font-family:Consolas,'Courier New',monospace;font-size:12.8px;line-height:1.75;background:var(--code-bg);
  border:1px solid var(--dim);border-radius:10px;padding:14px 16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre}
.tline{display:block;cursor:default;border-radius:4px;padding:0 4px}
.tline.clickable{cursor:pointer}
.tline.clickable:hover{background:rgba(0,240,255,.08);outline:1px solid rgba(0,240,255,.35)}
.tline.sel{background:rgba(255,242,0,.1);outline:1px solid var(--neon-yellow)}
.t-back{color:var(--neon-magenta)} .t-front{color:var(--neon-cyan)} .t-plain{color:var(--dim)}
.tree-info{border:1px dashed var(--neon-yellow);border-radius:10px;padding:10px 14px;margin-top:10px;font-size:13.5px;min-height:44px}

/* diagrama de flujo */
.flow{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin:10px 0}
.fbox{border:1px solid var(--neon-cyan);color:var(--neon-cyan);border-radius:9px;padding:9px 13px;
  font-size:13px;font-weight:700;box-shadow:0 0 6px rgba(0,240,255,.4);background:#0a0418}
.fbox.back{border-color:var(--neon-magenta);color:var(--neon-magenta);box-shadow:0 0 6px rgba(255,43,214,.4)}
.farrow{color:var(--neon-green);font-weight:800;font-size:13px;text-shadow:0 0 5px rgba(57,255,20,.5)}

/* toast */
.toast{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:26px;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(20px);opacity:0;
  background:#0a1a0a;border:1px solid var(--neon-green);color:var(--neon-green);padding:10px 22px;
  border-radius:9px;font-weight:800;font-size:14px;box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(57,255,20,.6);
  transition:opacity .18s, transform .18s;pointer-events:none;z-index:99}
.toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0)}

/* responsive */
@media(max-width:900px){
  .layout{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .sidebar{display:none;position:static;max-height:none}
  select.mobilenav{display:block}
  .gen-split{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}

</style>
